These changes could lead to increased reliance on high-interest private loans and reduce enrollment and diversity in graduate programs. Policy leaders, including Bryce McKibben of the Hope Center and Jessica Thompson of the Institute for College Access and Success, express deep concern that these changes will exacerbate financial stress and threaten student persistence and degree completion.
